reviews.author: Bianca
reviews.text: Great quality work! Quote was broken down very well and detailed. The fence came out looking seamless. It took our corner lot curb appeal to the next level. If you want professional work, call them today!

reviews.author: Zyndy Daigle
reviews.text: I had QC Solutions replace all the wood around my chimney and repaint everything — it turned out beautiful! Enrique did an amazing job. Super professional and easy to work with. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: E. Ortiz
reviews.text: QC Solutions just finished my new fence and I couldn't be happier. They installed and stained it with a beautiful cedar color — amazing and super solid. You can tell they don't cut corners. I'd definitely use them again!

summary: Wood fence installation, fence repairs and drywall repair for homes in Seabrook, League City and Friendswood.

about.title: We live and work here too.
text: We're a family-owned company serving the Bay Area. We live and work here too, and taking care of our neighbors' homes is a privilege we don't take lightly.
Our team is small by design, so every job gets personal attention from an experienced professional.
We refuse to cut corners and use only proven materials, with honest quotes and clear communication from the first visit to the last.
